real_name: Mohammed Ajmal Amir Kasab — real name kept in film
real_life_notes: The only 26/11 attacker captured alive. Pakistani national from Faridkot, Punjab, Pakistan. Hanged on 21 November 2012 in Pune's Yerwada Jail after a prolonged legal process. His capture was unique — his testimony, CCTV footage (Victoria Terminus attack), and DNA evidence formed the prosecutorial backbone of India's case against Pakistan's ISI nexus.
film_role: Film 1 Act 3 — Kasab is depicted during the 26/11 attack sequence. His capture provides the documentary evidence thread that Sanyal pursues in Film 2.
objective: Execute LeT operational orders; die as a martyr
real_status: Hanged 21 November 2012, Yerwada Jail, Pune. His trial produced the most comprehensive documentation of ISI's 26/11 role available in the public record.
loss_aversion_note: Extremely high λ=3.5 — indoctrinated operative who has been trained to overweight martyrdom gains and discount survival losses. Classical high-risk-tolerance framing.
